_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/keywords/test_manifest_from_library.py. t_mfl_thief is Thieving Amalgam's 'At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, you manifest the top card of that player's library', the library bound to the upkeeping player and the 2/2 put under the trigger's controller; t_mfl_gift is the same trigger without `controller`, so the upkeeping player manifests their own card; t_mfl_toll is Thieving Amalgam's 'Whenever a creature you control but don't own dies, its owner loses 2 life and you gain 2 life'.
